purpose: Teach: 病状/横綱/法王/君臨/演目/直訳/装い/床下

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の、本気で、絶対、病状、絶対、配慮、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure we take care of our staff's health conditions thoroughly. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Crisp consonants. Slight emphasis on the core directive. Professional distance maintained but underlying concern is real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。相撲の、本気で、絶対、横綱、絶対、当社の、絶対、広告、絶対、ご出演、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful to have the grand champion of sumo appear in our advertising campaign.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment with slight undertone of pride. Even pace, respectful tone. The cadence of someone reporting back to a superior with good news.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外の、本気で、絶対、法王、絶対、来日時、絶対、当社、絶対、敬意を表せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When the Pope visits from overseas, I want our company to show the appropriate respect.
lines.style: Clear directive with no room for interpretation. Firm but not harsh. Weight behind each phrase. The tone of someone stating expectations that will be met.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界に、本気で、絶対、君臨、絶対、する、絶対、競合、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're keeping close watch on our competitors as we establish leadership in the industry.
lines.style: Professional update delivered with quiet confidence. Measured pace, no hesitation. The rhythm of someone reporting completed strategic awareness to their superior.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 劇場貸切の、本気で、絶対、演目、絶対、社内行事で、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look into booking a theatre performance for an in-house company event. Make it happen.
lines.style: Direct instruction with expectation of action. Clipped delivery on the main points. No warmth but not unkind—this is simply how business gets done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外契約書、本気で、絶対、直訳、絶対、ではなく、絶対、意訳、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling the overseas contracts with careful interpretation, not just literal translation.
lines.style: Methodical report with emphasis on the proper approach being taken. Steady rhythm. Slight lift on showing that the right method is already in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の、本気で、絶対、装い、絶対、業務にふさわしく、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure all staff appearance is appropriate and professional for the work we do.
lines.style: Exacting standard laid out with calm authority. Measured delivery. The expectation is clear and non-negotiable, but delivered without anger or condescension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫の、本気で、絶対、床下、絶対、点検、絶対、定期、絶対、実施しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're conducting regular inspections of the warehouse floor and foundation as planned.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly warmer. Sense of closing a cycle of acknowledgments. Confident tone—all items are handled. Closing with the quiet satisfaction of tasks well-managed.
